summary: Add clock-driven live activity labels, accessible long-message disclosure, circular composer actions, a compact composer dock, lighter light-theme borders, and antialiased root text. Composer shapes remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Long operator messages initially show at most eight lines and 600 characters within a 176px total disclosure budget. Hosts supply Transcript now and optional turn.activity tagged Working/WaitingForAnswer state. LiveActivity requires the tagged state and uses strong static text ink. The shared header/work-log/live duration formatter pads secondary units: 3m 05s and 4h 07m, while 12s remains unpadded. Shared composer Send is a labelled 32px circle and history is a 28px ghost action. Restored drafts initialize runtime text before paint so placeholder guidance and send availability agree with the controlled field.
